name: Hilal Portal
tag: Mosque gateway + crescent / a monumental welcome
summary: A stepped monumental mosque portal and two low prayer halls share one foundation, with a crescent above the central entry.
why: The gateway, crescent, and central doorway share x=54. The lower prayer halls are mirrored around that axis; their arches share the same peak and floor heights. All three parts use one continuous architectural silhouette and a y=72 foundation. The crescent is built with exact circular arcs and sits in solid wall above the entry.
risk: The gateway is a more abstract mosque cue than a minaret. The crescent and low prayer halls make the Islamic architecture clearer; side windows simplify at 24 px.
key1: One monumental portal and two prayer halls
sub1: A compact mosque with a continuous foundation
sub2: An Islamic symbol integrated into the gateway
